{{Top|leg}}
'''Filtration Masks''' were used to supply [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] to patients in need of medical care. The mask could also be connected to bottle contained alternate atmospheric compounds in case the patient was not an oxygen-breather. Filtration Masks were standard items included in [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]]'s [[ECM-598 Medical Backpack]].
